stage: Research, failure-first causal localization and conditional bounded local repair
same_seed_normal_controls: existing B29 wait/stale, C29 narrow, C13 wait; no favorable scene replacement
primary_gate: exact previous protocol: goal, zero actor contact, dynamic full-envelope >=.047m, no sampled wall-envelope overlap
acceleration: separate measured contract, not a newly added or relaxed primary gate; source finite differences and command ramps reported
diagnosis: read full original raw; targeted ~3.6..5.8s telemetry only if missing native footprint/selected sequence prevents attribution
conditional_repair: only after original failure reproduction and concrete source/cycle counterexample; no weights/inflation/radius/velocity tuning; one main factor per cohort
hypothesis_to_test: native center-cost shortcut may suppress polygon collision checking when the inflation support is shorter than the robot circumscribed radius; unconfirmed until native exact check/counterexample
regression: repeat identical selected failed/normal/A/C/Oracle cases for any repair; fixed time/invalid input checks retained
heldout_phase: unchanged default phase0; new MPPI noise seed never used in prior study
bounds: <=24 incremental motion trials including repeats/holdout, <=300MiB new runtime cache, <=45MiB incremental compact evidence, >=3GiB free; no new ROS builds
stop: if no reproducible concrete local defect or repair needs optimizer/model framework rewrite, record Unknown/Model Limitation; stop at research verdict, no push/merge/hardware
